subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Emotion Recognition Technology
description: A 60-second lesson on Emotion Recognition Technology.

hook.text: A camera reads your face and claims to know if you're happy, sad, angry — or lying.

buildup.text: Emotion recognition AI analyzes facial expressions, voice tone, and body language to infer feelings.

discovery.text: Companies market it for job interviews, classrooms, and border security screening.

twist.text: Scientists say the technology is pseudoscience. Expressions don't reliably map to internal emotions.

climax.text: Emotion AI is being sold and deployed even as the science behind it crumbles under scrutiny.

punchline.text: It reads your face. It doesn't read your mind.

quiz.question: What do scientists say about emotion recognition technology?
options: Facial expressions don't reliably indicate internal emotions
It is 99% accurate at detecting lies
It only works in laboratory settings
